name: Generic MK8
description: The MK8-style extruder is a single-drive design that originated with the Makerbot MK8 and has since been widely cloned and sold by many manufacturers. It uses a hobbed pulley with a 1:1 gear ratio driven directly from a NEMA17 stepper. While inexpensive and extremely common on budget printers, it offers limited grip and torque compared to geared designs. Specifications vary significantly between vendors and revisions.
features: Very low cost and widely available
Compatible with direct drive and Bowden setups
Found on many entry-level FDM printers
